text: Pull request review: the lance flush writer retries on failure and leaves sqlite intact. Reviewer asked for a crash recovery test before merge.
Figma mockup for the onboarding permission flow. Trust screen shows the live egress counter at zero before asking for screen recording.
Terminal: cargo test output for the retrieval crate, four fusion tests passing, one reranker ablation ignored pending model download.
Standup notes: Priya owns the model registry ticket, checksum verification blocked on picking a hash format, decided sha256 in the manifest.
Browser: LanceDB documentation page about scalar indexes and metadata prefiltering for hybrid vector search.
Slack thread about the demo script: counterfactual cut first, then the privacy negative with the password manager on camera.
Code editor: writing the deletion-everywhere path, records cascade to chunks and graph edges, retention job runs it nightly.
Design review: the omnibar keeps the v1 keyboard model, escape closes, arrow keys cycle results, enter copies the evidence pack.
Spreadsheet: quarterly budget for the bench reference machine, one M1 with 8 gigabytes, latency numbers only published from it.
Email draft to the team about GitLab board conventions, lane labels and milestone names, CSV import steps for the roadmap.
Terminal: rustup toolchain install pinned via rust-toolchain.toml, clippy and rustfmt components, same version across all four machines.
Notes app: interview story outline, the walking skeleton shipped in week one instead of week three, findings folded into the ADRs.
